    Multiplication and powers of categorical Hom ideals #

    The product of two two-sided additive Hom ideals is generated by composites through arbitrary intermediate objects. This file proves the elementary ideal arithmetic needed to state nilpotence of a categorical radical and to deduce separation of its power filtration.
